quantity: Usage charges for the metered text-processing service
scope: SYNTHETIC example. One internal tool after rollout; usage charges only, no staff time or fixed fees

requests_per_workday.why: SYNTHETIC. The pilot logged 900 to 1,400 requests a day from 6 users. Rollout to 20 to 40 users could multiply that by 3 to 6, or adoption could stall. Surprised below 400 or above 6,000.

workdays.source: SYNTHETIC: organisation calendar for the period

thousand_units_per_request.why: SYNTHETIC. The pilot averaged 3.4 thousand billable units a request; document length varies about equally either side, so normal.

cached_share.why: SYNTHETIC. Repeated requests are answered from a cache at no charge. Only the pilot's worst and best weeks are known, so bounds only.

retry_overhead.why: SYNTHETIC. Failed calls are retried and billed again: usually 5 per cent extra, never less than none, 30 per cent in a bad month.

formula: requests_per_workday * workdays * (1 - cached_share) * thousand_units_per_request * price_per_thousand_units * retry_overhead

anchors.name: approved budget for the year (SYNTHETIC; a threshold, not a hard limit)
